Project remains on `release/2026.37`. Scheduler DST handling is complete: local schedule times are interpreted in the configured IANA timezone before UTC conversion, with New York midnight/wall-time regression coverage. Unknown timezones remain rejected. Currency rounding remains `ROUND_HALF_UP`; tax behavior and Ledgerly account models are intentionally unchanged. Legacy CSV export removal and richer account/export lifecycle modeling are deferred.

Billing worker reliability changes are complete. Pending events are removed only after successful charging and persistence, allowing failed events to remain available for retry. Incoming batches are copied before extending `pending_events`, preventing shared-list aliasing and unbounded accumulation. A redundant `_last_batch` reference was removed after it was found retaining charged events. Worker tests cover retry retention, batch isolation, and sequential batches; all pass. A 5,000-batch reproduction showed bounded peak memory (~7.3 MiB), settled retention (~2.1 MiB), and no pending events. A global retention audit found `self.completed_batches` still stores full payload dictionaries, including raw customer metadata; this likely needs a follow-up decision to avoid sensitive-data retention.

The latest full suite passes: **118 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed**.

Remaining work:
- Decide whether to reduce or remove `completed_batches` payload retention.
- Remove the 365-day minimum-retention restriction from `infra/bigquery-costs.md`.
- Make ledger posting-date ordering deterministic for nightly reconciliation.
- Raise debug-sampling threshold from 10% to 20%.
- Remove any temporary breakpoint, inspect the final diff, and rerun Ruff/tests as needed.
